business_rules: Existing files at the target path are overwritten.
The output id in the draft must match the filename stem.
behavior.summary: Load schemas, validate the draft, run cross-checks, then write canonical JSON (2-space indent) to <out>/.harness/sensors/<id>.json via os.CreateTemp + os.Rename for atomicity.

description: Happy path of /detect-sensors Phase B: a draft conforming to schemas/sensor.json is validated, cross-checked, and atomically written to <out>/.harness/sensors/<id>.json. The skill repeats this once per drafted sensor.

evidence.rationale: main() entry point that wires flag parsing to lib/sensor.ValidateAndPersist.
ValidateAndPersist runs schema + cross-checks and writes atomically.

invariants: File at the printed path exists.
File content equals the draft after canonicalisation.
side_effects: Intermediate temp file under the same directory is removed on success.
expected_outcome.summary: Stdout has the absolute path of the written file; exit code is 0.

name: write-sensor validates and writes a valid sensor draft

trigger.summary: Skill invokes write-sensor.go with --out=<project-root> and a draft path.
